text: Every wallet on Solana is an open book. Anyone can see what you hold, and every trade you make.

Vanish is a privacy protocol for Solana, built on the same principle as Tornado Cash. Everyone deposits into one shared pool, and zero-knowledge proofs break the link between who puts money in, and who takes it out.
Shield Solana, dollars or tokenized stocks into the pool. Only your key can ever spend them.
Swap privately, right inside the pool. Solana into NVIDIA, dollars into stocks. Your wallet never appears.
Or buy any token, even a fresh pump dot fun launch, and receive it in a brand new wallet with no link back to you.
Every action is a proof, checked on-chain. No one can freeze your funds.
Vanish. Shield, swap and buy, without a trail. Try it at vanish dot website.
